distance_model.provenance: Sava et al. 2015 (Evaluating Lost Person Behavior Models) quotes ISRID 'temperate flat' 75% within 2 km. Not hiker-specific.

trail_model.provenance: ASSUMED. Direction supported by Mitchell 1984 (75% of hikers followed a trail or drainage at some point while lost). Magnitude is a modelling choice, not published data.
